text: In Taipei, as [the government plays down the flu-like Alvin virus|wrong|failing to protect] ahead of a re-election, Jim drops his girlfriend Kat at the train station. In a café, an old woman spits on a customer who [turns on everyone around him|threat|sickness and poison], and on Kat's subway train a stranger begins stabbing passengers. The infected keep their speech and intelligence but [crave to act out every violent, sadistic impulse|wants|cruelty and destruction], and as [the whole city tears itself apart|who_suffers|whole communities], Jim and Kat try to reach each other.
